verdict.rationale: Teller is a bank-data and payments API (accounts, balances, transactions, identity, payments, webhooks). It is not an agent or AI host that consumes external tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP client or tool-plugin capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
